# LEAP: Laboratory for the Economics of Africa's Past

> {{ site.data.site.mission | strip_newlines }}

LEAP is a research centre in the Department of Economics, Faculty of Economic and Management Sciences, Stellenbosch University, South Africa. It was established in 2015 and has been a Type-1 research centre since 2023. Director: Prof. Johan Fourie. Contact: {{ site.data.site.email }}.

## Pages

- [Home]({{ '/' | absolute_url }}): mission, latest news, current projects and working papers
- [News]({{ '/news/' | absolute_url }}): appointments, conferences, lectures and new research
- [Research]({{ '/research/' | absolute_url }}): current projects, LEAP working papers and published articles
- [Team]({{ '/team/' | absolute_url }}): researchers, the Governing Board and PhD graduates since 2016
- [Data]({{ '/data/' | absolute_url }}): open historical datasets, CC BY 4.0, with codebooks and R loaders
- [Contact]({{ '/contact/' | absolute_url }}): Schumann Building, Bosman Street, Stellenbosch 7600, South Africa
